a:r.a:t: Hydropathy Plots Can Predict Transmembrane Domains

p:cNvPr.descr: Hydropathy plots showing hydrophilic and hydrophobic tendencies of (a) glycophorin and (b) bacteriorhodopsin. The top plot, (a) shows the hydropathy pattern of glycophorin, labeled below. The vertical axis is labeled “hydropathy index,” has range -3 to 3, with interval 3. The horizontal axes, top and bottom, show the residue number, have range 0 to 130, with intervals 50 and 30. There is a horizontal line across the plot, beginning at 0 and ending at 130 on the horizontal axis. The area above this line contains hydrophobic residues (shown by an up arrow at right) and the area below it contains hydrophilic residues (shown by a down arrow at right). The background of the graph is medium gray. For glycophorin, all residues are hydrophobic (below the central line) and gray except for a peaked region between residue number 75 and 90, peaking at about 2.8 on the hydropathy index. This region is shaded bright yellow. Below this is the second graph, (b). It shows the hydropathy index of bacteriorhodopsin. In stark contrast, this graph has almost all hydrophobic residues (above the line) which are shaded various colors. The graph setup is exactly the same as in (a). Beginning on the left, segment 1 is shaded purple, ranges from residue 20 to 40, and peaks at about 2.2. Next, there is a narrow gray hydrophilic segment below the line. To the right is segment 2, which is blue and ranges from residue 50 to 80, peaking at about 2.3. To the right there is a narrow gray hydrophilic segment below the line. To the right of this is segment 3, which is shaded teal and ranges from residue 100 to 120, peaking at 2.8. Immediately to the right is segment 4, which is shaded bright green, ranges from residue 120 to 140 and peaks at 2.4. A tiny gray hydrophilic segment is to the right. To the right of this is segment 5, which is shaded bright yellow, ranges from residue 150 to 170, and peaks at 2.7. To the right is a very deep gray hydrophilic segment. To the right of this is residue 6, which is shaded orange and ranges from residue 180 to 210 and peaks at 2.2. Immediately right is segment 7, which is shaded red and ranges from residue 210 to 230, peaking at 2.5. To the right, the remainder of the plot is hydrophilic and gray.
